SELECT 
    MIN("Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS LowestFreeRate,
    MAX("Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS HighestFreeRate,
    AVG("Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS AverageFreeRate
FROM 
    frpm
WHERE 
    "Age Group" = '5-17';

SELECT 
    MIN("Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS Lowest_Free_Rate,
    MAX("Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS Highest_Free_Rate,
    AVG("Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS Average_Free_Rate
FROM 
    frpm
WHERE 
    "Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL;

SELECT 
    MIN("Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS LowestFreeRate,
    MAX("Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS HighestFreeRate,
    AVG("Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS AverageFreeRate
FROM 
    frpm;

SELECT DISTINCT "Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm
WHERE "School Type" = 'Continuation Schools'
ORDER BY "Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)" ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    School, 
    Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)
FROM 
    frpm
WHERE 
    School Type = 'Continuation Schools'
ORDER BY 
    "Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)" ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT MIN(`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS LowestEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm
WHERE `School Type` = 'Continuation Schools'
ORDER BY LowestEligibleFreeRate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    frpm.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)]
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE 
    schools.SchoolType LIKE '%Continuation%'
ORDER BY 
    frpm.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)] ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    frpm.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)]
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE 
    schools.SchoolType LIKE '%Continuation%'
ORDER BY 
    frpm.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)] ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    frpm.School_Name,
    frpm.Percent___Eligible_Free_Ages_5_17 AS Free_Rate
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.School_Name = schools.School
WHERE 
    frpm.Educational_Option_Type = 'Continuation High Schools'
ORDER BY 
    frpm.Percent___Eligible_Free_Ages_5_17 ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    frpm.School_Name,
    frpm.Percent___Eligible_Free_Ages_5_17 AS Eligible_Free_Rate
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.School_Name = schools.School
WHERE 
    schools.District = 'Albert Einstein Continuation'
ORDER BY 
    frpm.Percent___Eligible_Free_Ages_5_17 ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    frpm.School_Name,
    frpm.Percent___Eligible_Free_Ages_5_17
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.School_Name = schools.School
WHERE 
    frpm.Educational_Option_Type = 'Continuation High Schools'
ORDER BY 
    frpm.Percent___Eligible_Free_Ages_5_17 ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    frpm.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)]
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE 
    schools.StatusType = 'Active'
ORDER BY 
    frpm.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)] ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    frpm.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)]
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE 
    schools.StatusType LIKE '%Continuation%'
ORDER BY 
    frpm.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)] ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE 
    schools.StatusType = 'Continuation'
ORDER BY 
    frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    MIN(`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS Lowest_Free_Rate
FROM 
    frpm
WHERE 
    `Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
    `Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`
LIMIT 3;
